uutiset.t: Puerto Rico’s Supreme Court cancels major power contract

uutiset.s: President Lula’s office says Brazil will not yield to threats and aims for a negotiated resolution.

uutiset.s: Dario Amodei's remarks come amid predictions that AI may soon match or surpass human intelligence.
